Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.12 fixes the harem bracelet possession check: eligibility now follows buy, sell, buyback and gift events instead of an inventory-slot or instance-ID lookup, so giving the bracelet for free no longer fails to register the harem route. Existing saves scan once on first load; a failed gift can be repaired before the solo romance starts. The 1.11 portrait selector, 1.10 voice pass and earlier entry, hit-area and portrait-compatibility fixes remain. Simplified Chinese / English. 1.12 修复后宫线手镯持有判定：资格改为按买入、卖出、回购、赠送事件计数，不再依赖库存格或实例 ID，免费赠送后不会漏记后宫资格；旧档首次载入扫描一次，尚未进入普通恋爱/告白的失败赠送可修复。1.11 立绘选择、1.10 voice pass 与更早的入线、点击区、立绘兼容修复保留。简体中文 / English。
